+### Step 4: Persist Deliverable + Post-save Verification
+
+Before ending, always write the required artifact to the exact requested path and verify it round-trips.
+
+```python
+from pathlib import Path
+import pandas as pd
+
+out_path = Path(output_path)
+df.to_csv(out_path, index=False)
+
+assert out_path.exists() and out_path.stat().st_size > 0
+check = pd.read_csv(out_path)
+assert list(check.columns) == list(df.columns)
+```
+
+Decision rule: treat “file written and re-opened successfully” as a completion gate; if any assertion fails, fix the pipeline/output formatting and re-save.

+## Common Pitfalls
+
+- Ending the run without writing the required output artifact to disk.
+- Formatting floats but not verifying the saved CSV round-trips (schema/order, non-empty file).
+- Using range “clamping” as the primary mechanism instead of conversion (clamp only for small tolerance/precision edge cases).
+- Parsing commas incorrectly (decimal vs thousands); decide the dataset’s convention before replacing.
